units.raw_text: Designed the Threadline factory-comms scheduler — a Postgres-backed job system with idempotent retries, dead-letter queues per factory, and a SLA-violation alert path that pages the factory's dedicated CS owner. Replaces what would otherwise be Sidekiq plus a separate alerting stack; a single engineer maintains it.
units.normalized_summary: Designed Threadline factory-comms scheduler — Postgres-backed job system with idempotent retries, per-factory dead-letter queues, and SLA-violation alert path replacing Sidekiq plus separate alerting stack

units.raw_text: Built the Pliant async job system on top of Postgres LISTEN/NOTIFY plus a row-level locking pattern. Replaced the existing Sidekiq deployment for the workflow execution path; reduced per-job p99 latency by 60% and removed Redis as a tier-1 dependency.
units.normalized_summary: Built Pliant async job system on Postgres LISTEN/NOTIFY plus row-level locking, replacing Sidekiq for workflow execution; reduced per-job p99 latency by 60% and removed Redis as tier-1 dependency

item.text: At Threadline, built a Postgres job system on LISTEN/NOTIFY that cut per-job p99 latency by 60% and removed Redis as a tier-1 dependency.

assertions.text: Built a Postgres-backed job system at Threadline.
The Threadline job system was built on Postgres LISTEN/NOTIFY.
The Threadline job system cut per-job p99 latency by 60%.
The Threadline job system removed Redis as a tier-1 dependency.

notes: Draft. The LISTEN/NOTIFY, p99 -60% and Redis facts belong to the Pliant job system (u_async_jobs_postgres, included uncited); the cited Threadline scheduler supports only a Postgres-backed job system.
